summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature without running any code or committing. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch now yields (patch, coords) with inline coordinate computation; set_rnd skips double-underscore attributes), monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter; GridPatchDataset reworked to take patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates; NotImplementedError on missing length; PatchDataset docstring np.float -> float; math import replaced by numpy), monai/data/__init__.py (exports PatchIter), docs/source/data.rst (PatchIter autodoc entry), and a new tests/test_grid_dataset.py with TestGridPatchDataset (test_shape, test_loading_array, plus an extra test_missing_length). Expected values in test_loading_array were taken from the spec and assume the source images are arange(16) reshaped to 1x4x4. Not verified: tests were not run, and existing callers/tests of iter_patch were not checked beyond a grep finding no other callers. The GridPatchDataset docstring example output was derived by reasoning, not executed.
